title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling examples, and docs site quickstarts
author: Avery Chen
body:
Summary: Adds a set of RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) agent templates, tool-calling example playbooks, and quickstart docs updates for the docs site and redwood-examples. This PR provides opinionated starter templates for common RAG patterns (FAQ bot, agent tool orchestration, multi-tool pipelines), 3 tool-calling examples (search + database + webhook), and a docs site quickstart with embedded runnable code samples and verified preview build.

Motivation: Customers frequently ask for production-ready RAG examples and agent starter kits. This makes it easier for engineers to get started with tool-calling patterns and safe agent scaffolding while ensuring docs and examples remain in sync with the SDK changes from the last release.

What changed (high level):
- Added /examples/rag-templates/ with 4 opinionated templates (faq-bot, ticket-assistant, research-agent, pipeline-orchestrator).
- Added /examples/tool-calling/ with 3 end-to-end examples (search+embed, postgres-retriever, webhook-action).
- Updated docs site: docs/guides/rag-quickstart.md, docs/reference/agent-templates.md and sidebar config to include quickstarts.
- Added integration tests for examples under tests/integration/rag_examples_test.py and a CI job to validate sample runs on the preview infra.
- Minor SDK docs updates and code samples compatibility tweaks for the Python SDK v1.7.2.

Checklist:
- [x] Add templates and examples
- [x] Docs quickstart + sidebar update
- [x] Integration tests and CI preview config
- [x] Verify snippets + runnable examples in preview site
- [x] Address security review for tool-calling patterns (sanitization + least-privilege notes)

Testing notes:
- Ran examples locally and in preview cluster; integration tests pass in the preview environment.
- Verified docs preview build at https://deploy-preview-1280--docs.redwood.ai/quickstart/rag (internal preview).
- Manual security review from Priya Nair on tool-calling patterns included guidance on rate limits and credential handling (implemented in README examples).

Upgrade/migration notes:
- No breaking API changes. Some example snippets reference Python SDK v1.7.2 (callouts added).
- Users installing example shells should follow the README to generate API keys and set REDWOOD_API_KEY env var; doc includes minimal troubleshooting hints.

Rollout plan:
- Merge to main, let docs CI promote preview to production after 1 day and manual spot-checks.
- Monitor metrics: docs preview errors, example CI flakiness, and initial community feedback.

Files of interest (high level):
- examples/rag-templates/faq-bot/README.md
- examples/rag-templates/research-agent/template.py
- examples/tool-calling/search_postgres_webhook/README.md
- docs/guides/rag-quickstart.md
- docs/reference/agent-templates.md
- docs/_sidebar.yml
- tests/integration/rag_examples_test.py
- .github/workflows/docs-preview.yml (new job: examples-preview)

release_notes:
- Added RAG agent templates (FAQ, research, ticket assistant, pipeline orchestrator) and tool-calling examples.
- Docs: new RAG quickstart and agent templates reference.
- Integration tests and docs-preview CI for runnable examples.
notes_for_oncall: No runtime changes; if docs-preview fails, the examples-preview job will alert SRE. Integration test failures for examples run only affect preview and are disabled for main release gating.
